modmenu.descriptionTranslation.random-cr: Let's randomize crafts for each world! Let the chaos begin...
gamerule.minecraft.randomize_crafts.desc: Randomizes all crafting recipes when the world is created
gamerule.minecraft.rc_balanced_tiers.des: Recipes will be generated according to tiers (levels) to ensure game balance. Disabling this rule will make the game more hardcore!
gamerule.minecraft.rc_exclude_color_bloc: Colored variants (wool, glass, concrete, etc.) will not be used as ingredients.
gamerule.minecraft.rc_exclude_tools_armo: Tools and armor will not be used as ingredients in recipes.
gamerule.minecraft.rc_exclude_functional: Crafting tables, furnaces and other functional blocks will not be used as ingredients.
gamerule.minecraft.rc_tier_spread.descri: [1-20] Higher values increase the chance that end-game items will require basic materials. Only works when 'Balanced Tiers' is enabled.
If enabled, recipes unlock based on the randomized ingredients. If disabled, recipes unlock based on original vanilla item dependencies.

message.random_crafts.generate_success: [Random Crafts] Successfully generated recipes with seed: %s! Reloading world...
message.random_crafts.clear: [Random Crafts] RandomCrafts disabled and cleared. Reloading...
message.random_crafts.no_active: [Random Crafts] RandomCrafts is not active in this world.
message.random_crafts.rule_changed: [Random Crafts] Gamerule %s has been changed. Use /rc generate to apply changes.
